System: Al–Cr–Fe–Mn–Ti quinary system (specifically Al20Cr5Fe50Mn20Ti5 and Al15Cr5Fe50Mn25Ti5 as successful cases). System: Refractory High-Entropy Alloy WTaMoNbV (20 at.% W, 20 at.% Ta, 20 at.% Mo, 20 at.% Nb, 20 at.% V).
